title: Shafukan taimako, SEO masu gaskiya da auna abin da ke aiki

say: Shafuka masu taimako, SEO masu gaskiya, da auna abin da ke aiki.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo na module uku na SEO hanya.
Google ya ce tsarin sa yana da nufin ba da lada ga abubuwan da aka yi musamman don taimakawa mutane, ba abubuwan da aka yi akasari zuwa matsayi ba.
Shafukan farko na mutane sun fito daga gwaninta na gaske, suna amsa ainihin tambayar abokin ciniki, kuma suna nuna fayyace farashi, hotuna da bayanan gida.

right: An rubuta kawai don buga kalmomi masu mahimmanci

say: Shafukan bincike-farko suna bin kalmomi masu mahimmanci, kwafi wasu kuma ku sanya kirga kalmar.
Yawancin ƙananan shafukan kasuwanci suna kasawa kawai saboda kusan ba su ce komai ba: taken, hoto, kuma a kira mu.

say: Jagororin ƙimar Google suna magana game da E-E-AT: ƙwarewa, ƙwarewa, iko da amana. Amincewa ya fi muhimmanci.
Don ƙananan kasuwanci, wannan yana nufin abubuwa masu sauƙi, ainihin abubuwa. Nuna wanda ke gudanar da kasuwancin da kuma inda yake.

say: Yi amfani da ainihin hotuna na aikin ku. Wata mai kula da abincin da ta dafa jollof don bukukuwan aure na baƙi 300, tare da hotunanta, ta nuna kwarewar labarin da aka kwafi ba zai iya ba.

say: Google galibi yana duba nau'in wayar hannu na shafinku, kuma yawancin baƙi suna amfani da wayoyi akan bayanai masu tsada.
Misali, Ifeoma tana sayar da riguna na Ankara. A cikin PageSpeed ​​​​Insights, shafin tarinta yana ɗaukar daƙiƙa 6.8 don nuna babban abun ciki. Ana kiran wannan ma'aunin LCP.

panel.heading: Ifeoma ta sa shafinta yayi saurin lodawa
items: Halayen Saurin Shafi: LCP 6.8 seconds, Talauci
Maimaita hotuna zuwa pixels 1200, ajiye azaman WebP
Kunna kaya malalaci
Cire bidiyon baya da plugin ɗin da ba a yi amfani da shi ba
Sake gwadawa: LCP 2.3 seconds, Yayi kyau

say: Wasu masu siyarwa sunyi alkawarin sakamako mai sauri ta hanyar dabaru. Shafukan da ke karya manufofin spam na Google na iya yin ƙasa da ƙasa ko bacewa.
Saƙon hanyar haɗi yana nufin siyan hanyoyin haɗin yanar gizo waɗanda suka wuce ƙimar daraja. Misali, an baiwa Grace 500 backlinks akan naira 40,000. Tace a'a.

Ajiye rahoton zuwa shafi ɗaya, tare da layi mai haske ɗaya a ƙarƙashin kowace lamba.
